## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- LFV planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 143.5M€2022, of which 59.4% relates to new major investments. LFV planned 3 new major investments for RP4, of which 2 have started and 1 has not yet started.

- In 2025, LFV underspent -0.1M€2022 (-23.2%) in costs related to new major investments. This is mainly attributable to some delays.

- According to the reporting tables, LFV overspent +0.3M€2022 (+2.1%) in costs related to investments in 2025.

- LFV reported 3.1M€2022 in funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
